task_description: Simplify product and order IDs to human-friendly format (ORD-0001, PRD-001, VPN-0001, PXY-0001) using Firebase counters, and add admin order lookup by ID feature

verification.summary: AST parse passes. Post-review fixes applied: (1) generate_id now uses Firebase transaction() for atomic counter increment, (2) admin order lookup validates input with regex before querying Firebase to prevent path injection, (3) prefix-aware routing reduces redundant lookups from 3 to 1.
